author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅನುಭವದ ಕೊರತೆಯಿರೆ ತಪವದನ ತುಂಬುವುದು
ತನುಮನವು ತಪದಲಿರೆ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹುಟ್ಟು
ಅನುಗಾಲವೊರತೆಯಿರೆ ತೊಡಗಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ
ಕನಸುಕೈಗೂಡುವವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Where experience is lacking, austerity fills the gap;
when body and mind are in tapas, achievement is born;
when the strength to engage flows like a spring at every moment,
dreams come true, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Discipline makes up for inexperience; achievement is born of sustained effort (tapas). With constant energy and engagement, dreams become reality.
